decks.name: Reporting Verbs
decks.description: Los 3 grupos: verb + to-inf, verb + persona + to-inf, verb + -ing.

cards.en: Pablo promised to tidy his room.
The children refused to go to bed.
cards.es: Los chicos se negaron a ir a dormir.

cards.en: Sam's neighbour threatened to call the police.
cards.es: El vecino de Sam amenazó con llamar a la policía.

cards.en: Bill advised me to keep my money in the bank.
cards.es: Bill me aconsejó guardar la plata en el banco.

cards.en: Molly reminded Jack to phone the electrician.
cards.es: Molly le recordó a Jack que llamara al electricista.

cards.en: Peter invited me to have dinner.
The boss persuaded Megan not to leave.
cards.es: El jefe convenció a Megan de no irse.

cards.en: Ryan suggested going for a walk.

cards.es: Ruby negó haber comido los chocolates.

cards.en: Roger apologized for forgetting my birthday.
cards.es: Roger se disculpó por olvidarse de mi cumpleaños.

cards.en: The teacher accused Simon of copying Anna's exam.
cards.es: El profe acusó a Simon de copiarse del examen de Anna.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'Bill advised me ____ my money in the bank.'
questions.explanation: advise + persona + to + verbo: Bill advised me to keep my money in the bank.

questions.prompt: Completa: 'Ella insistió en que había un error.' → 'She _______ that there was a mistake.'
Completa: 'Él negó haber robado nada.' → 'He _______ stealing anything.'
questions.explanation: deny + -ing expresa negación; refuse + to + verbo expresa rechazo.

questions.prompt: ¿Qué oración usa correctamente say o tell para comunicarle algo a una persona?
options: She told the news to I.
She said to me about the news.
questions.explanation: En esta construcción: tell someone something; say something to someone. Por ejemplo: She said hello to me.

questions.prompt: Completa el pasado del verbo claim (afirmar): 'She _______ that she saw the accident.'
